summary: Verified founder's authenticated-app visual batch on WEB. All 6 flows PASS on cathy@example.com (Family, 168 anomalies). (1) Things-To-Know: list capped at exactly 10 items; button reads 'View all 168 things to know' → click expands ul to 168 li, label flips to 'Show fewer'; second click collapses back to 10. (2) Each Things-To-Know item renders the redesign: severity badge ('Heads up' verified), title, summary, 'What to do' callout, 'Why we flagged this' expander, and 'View statement' link pointing to /app/statements/{id}. (3) Budget Detail toggle: dashboard-more-detail-btn shows only 'Show Detail' when closed and only 'Hide Detail' when open (other span is display:none via group-open). (4) Global header (app-topbar) in BOTH light and dark: brand-link, GlobalSearch (lg), LCA1AlertsBell, NotificationsBell, AccountHealthMenu, ParticipantSwitcher, layout-plan-badge (Family), logout-button ('Sign out' visible on xl+, color rgb(240,228,213) in dark = cream on dark bg — legible), and mobile layout-menu-button all present; no header overflow at 1440px (scrollWidth == offsetWidth) in light OR dark. Mobile viewport 390: menu-button visible, logout hidden as intended, brand visible. (5) SmartAISummary present as data-testid=smart-ai-summary-dashboard with bg-gradient-to-br from-[#135A61] to-[#123F44] (linear-gradient rgb(19,90,97) → rgb(18,63,68)) — matches the 'slightly lighter teal' spec, white text readable. (6) REGRESSION: header renders correctly with no overflow on /app/statements, /app/invoices, /settings/billing (in dark mode) — brand, logout, plan-badge all present. 0 blocking console errors (only benign GSI initialize warnings + a 403 for the Google client-id origin, unrelated to this batch).
critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking: CaregiverDashboard.jsx uses <details> with a Tailwind group-open trick for the Budget Detail toggle — visually correct in this render, but relying on native <details> open state means the label state cannot be toggled programmatically without a click (Playwright had to setAttribute('open','') to inspect). Consider a controlled useState if any future test/automation needs to drive it deterministically. Current UX is fine.

Non-blocking: the terracotta 'Alert' badge branch wasn't visually observed because the first ~10 anomalies in Cathy's seed are all 'Heads up' severity; code path is present at line 526-528 with the bg-terracotta class. If founder wants to spot-check the red variant, seed a severity='alert' anomaly.

success_rate.frontend: web 100% (6/6 flows: TTK cap+toggle, TTK item structure, Budget Detail label, header light+dark+mobile, SmartAISummary, 3-page regression)
